query:
select kind as "kind!", sum(amount_tyiyn)::bigint as "sum!"
           from cash_movements
           where account_id = $1 and created_at >= $2
             and (created_at < coalesce($3, 'infinity'::timestamptz)
                  or (created_at = $3 and kind <> 'count_diff'))
           group by kind order by kind
